tagline: 禄来胶片单反相机，1984 年发布
description: 禄来于1984年推出的胶片单反相机。配备Bayonet mount Rollei (license built Carl Zeiss) Planar 2.8/80mm with HFT coating.。使用6x6 or 4.5x6 on 120 or 220 film types, depending on exchangeable film magazine used.。

specs.胶片/画幅: 6x6 or 4.5x6 on 120 or 220 film types, depending on exchangeable film magazine used.
specs.镜头: Bayonet mount Rollei (license built Carl Zeiss) Planar 2.8/80mm with HFT coating.
specs.英文简介: The Rolleiflex 6006 is a medium format SLR system camera manufactured by Rollei, Braunschweig, Germany.
